latest_news.headline: Israel-Hezbollah truce renewed after morning flare-up
latest_news.text: PBS, DW, Time, NBC and France 24 report Israel and Hezbollah renewed a truce after intensified fighting threatened US-Iran talks; Haaretz says IDF forces will remain in southern Lebanon. Net effect is slightly lower raw risk, still near ceiling because the truce is fragile.

latest_news.headline: UN/OHCHR warn RSF offensive around El Obeid may be imminent
latest_news.text: OHCHR, UN News, Reuters, Sudan Tribune and regional feeds warn that RSF forces are massing around El Obeid and that an assault would carry catastrophic civilian risk. Configured force-posture lane refreshed; no Red Sea spillover found.

latest_news.headline: Hormuz traffic improving but still cautious under Iranian transit terms
latest_news.text: NYT and Reuters report oil shipments rising and vessels moving cautiously through Hormuz while questions remain over transit terms; Al Jazeera and oil feeds show residual risk premium. No stoppage or oil-facility strike was corroborated.

latest_news.headline: US-Iran talks stall; monitoring channel still not dead
latest_news.text: ABC7, Times of Israel, Daily Sabah, Xinhua and Fox report Vance trip changes and postponed or stalled US-Iran talks as key rifts remain. Earlier agency-visit reporting keeps monitoring channels alive; no verified technical breakpoint surfaced.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan denies Afghan strike claims but confirms drone interception
latest_news.text: Arab News, Dawn and Express Tribune report Pakistan denying Afghan/Taliban-linked cross-border strike claims while saying one drone was intercepted; other feeds still frame border tensions as escalating. Severe claims remain contested.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine drone wave hits Moscow/refinery targets; Russia warns escalation
latest_news.text: PBS, CNBC, NBC, ISW, Washington Post, NYT and NPR report a major Ukrainian drone wave against Moscow/refinery targets and Russian escalation warnings. Battlefield stress remains ceiling-level; no NATO war-entry breakpoint surfaced.
sources: Institute for the Study of War

latest_news.headline: US Europe force-posture review keeps allied churn high
latest_news.text: AP, CBS, US official material and European feeds report Hegseth announcing a review of US forces in Europe and pressing allies on burden-sharing. This is allied posture churn, not Article 5 activation or direct combat entry.

latest_news.headline: DPRK rejects G7 denuclearisation demand; no configured weapons-event trigger
latest_news.text: A News, Yonhap, Straits Times and regional feeds report North Korea rejecting G7 denuclearisation demands and defending strategic status. The tracker has no configured rhetoric lane; no fresh weapons-event trigger was corroborated.

latest_news.headline: Jerusalem and West Bank holy-site pressure persists
latest_news.text: WAFA reports more than 60,000 worshippers at Al-Aqsa; Haaretz reports an East Jerusalem eviction case; Dawn/Khaleej/Pakistan Today report eight states condemning attacks on West Bank mosques. Holy-site pressure remains active without wider breakout.

latest_news.headline: China-Taiwan quasi-quarantine watch remains trigger-adjacent, not breakout
latest_news.text: Jamestown reports quasi-quarantine operations east of Taiwan; Straits Times reports Ukrainian drone makers targeting Asian demand amid Taiwan tensions. No full blockade or invasion-prep breakpoint was corroborated.

latest_news.headline: Russia-NATO direct lane unchanged
latest_news.text: Russia/NATO fallback found allied posture review and older strategic commentary, not Article 5 activation, direct combat-entry decision, or fresh official strategic-threat breakpoint.

latest_news.headline: India-Pakistan: airspace ban persists, no fresh clash
latest_news.text: Pakistan Today reports Pakistan extended its airspace ban on Indian aircraft until July 24; no fresh verified India-Pakistan border clash or immediate force-posture breakout surfaced.

latest_news.headline: Energy sanity check: Brent/WTI near high-70s/low-80s; Hormuz risk premium easing
latest_news.text: Local cache before deploy shows Brent near $79.80 and WTI near $76.19; oil RSS headlines say Gulf flows are resuming and the risk premium is easing, though insurance/transit uncertainty remains.

latest_news.headline: UN reachable; direct IAEA pages still blocked from host
latest_news.text: UN News and UN Press RSS were reachable from this host. Direct IAEA news, press and RSS probes again returned HTTP 403, so IAEA details rely on UN/Google News RSS mirrors and media reporting during this pass.

latest_news.headline: Turkey-NATO no-trigger review
latest_news.text: Fallback returned Ankara/NATO summit, Black Sea strategy and defense-sales items, not a fresh Turkish operational or strategic-arms trigger item.

latest_news.headline: South Sudan/Abyei no-trigger review
latest_news.text: Targeted fallback returned old peacekeeping/Abyei items and no fresh Abyei clash, UNISFA crisis, or force-escalation item.
